title: Metropolis Random Walks Escape Deep Basins Faster in Higher Dimensions

lem:transport.summary: A nearest-neighbor current redistributes uniform mass to the next cube with bounded energy.
lem:transport.step: Lean checked the one-dimensional construction for all radii, including both endpoints and radius zero.
lem:transport.scope: One-dimensional case only. Lean scales the uniform masses and currents by the common positive denominator and checks the divergence identity and the denominator-cleared energy inequality. The higher-dimensional construction is open.
lem:transport.next: Lift each interval current to a coordinate line and prove that the resulting currents have additive energy.

subproofs.title: One-dimensional divergence and energy bound for all radii
